evidence.note: Runs targeted triangle parity tests, then lists failing test groups — driving implementation from per-component test results rather than compile success.
Repeated byte-level golden-vs-actual diff inspection per component (bif/noa/eda diffs, 'verbose', 'diff via file') to pinpoint exact divergences and guide fixes.

Auxiliary finer-grained probes: diff default vs noshadow, show colors block with markers (whitespace/format inspection), non-shadow link columns, compare inline vs between annotations — isolating formatting vs ordering vs algorithmic causes.
Inspects single_node golden (minimal input) to localize a format/edge-case mismatch, leading to MinMax fix — reproducing a mismatch on a smallest input.
Runs full workspace suite and tracks pass/fail counts, but as a supplement to diff-level debugging, not a substitute.
Cross-validates against Java by extracting exact algorithms from reference source (not by executing Java to produce outputs), so behavioral cross-validation stays at source-reading level.

reasoning: The agent consistently drives implementation from the golden diffs: focused per-component test invocations plus pervasive byte-level bif/noa/eda diff inspection to pinpoint divergences, augmented by auxiliary probes (marker/whitespace display, section comparisons, default-vs-noshadow diffs, minimal single_node inputs) that isolate format from ordering from algorithmic causes — matching the level-8 anchor. It falls short of 10 because cross-validation of Java behavior is via source reading rather than execution, and there is no explicit verification that green tests exercise the real path.
